853:t_72:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Eek... 'Flat-foot' is young people's slang for 'the greatest warrior'!」

853:t_72:11.en:
$$ゼウス$$
「Is that so...? Then very well.」

853:t_72:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That was close, that was close... Why do gods of this type overreact so much to the words 'flat feet'...)

853:t_73:4.en:
$$赤木$$
「Ha ha... you're making me blush. I'm not exactly ace material.」

853:t_73:5.en:
$$青山$$
「True. 'Ace salaryman' sounds a little odd, too.」

853:t_73:6.en:
$$いぶき$$
「If you're going to get something anyway, wouldn't a job position make you happier than a title?」

853:t_73:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And one more as a bonus! Happy Section Chief Pilot!」

853:t_73:10.en:
$$赤木$$
「Hmm... it's so realistic that I don't really feel like I'm being praised...」

853:t_73:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Maybe I should have called you 'President' and told you to dream big, at least in a setting like this.」

853:t_73:12.en:
$$青山$$
「When AG does that, it turns into a tout from the nightlife district.」

853:t_74:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ロジャー$$!」

853:t_74:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Thank you, AG. That said, that title is not one I wished for.」

853:t_74:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand how you feel. But what the Earth needs right now is the power to defeat the enemy.」

853:t_74:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You may not like it, Mr. $$ロジャー$$, but as a member of $c, you should first wield your strength against the crisis before your eyes.」

853:t_74:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Sound reasoning, plus flattering the other party... Quite a skillful way with words.」

853:t_74:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Do you think I could become a Negotiator, too?」

853:t_74:10.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I suppose. If you let me repaint your body solid black, I would even take you on as my assistant.」

853:t_74:11.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「In that case, it would be the birth of the worst duo.」

853:t_75:6.en:
$$ベック$$
「Hey, you... wanna team up with me?」

853:t_75:8.en:
$$ベック$$
「Yeah. I've got a feeling that if you and I team up, we could pull off something even bigger.」

853:t_75:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It is a very attractive offer, but...」

853:t_75:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The truth is, I don't like working under anyone.」

853:t_75:11.en:
$$ベック$$
「Knew it! That's where I picked up the scent of my own kind!」

853:t_75:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, with you, I might be able to build a partnership of equals.」

853:t_75:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Once this war is over, I will give your offer, Mr. $$ベック$$, positive consideration.」

853:t_76:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「But no matter how many enemy units I alone shoot down, the course of the war won't change.」

853:t_76:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Quite so. In your case, Mr. $$宗介$$, there's one opponent you'd rather bring down than a hundred run-of-the-mill enemies.」

853:t_76:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... in terms of toughness, I'd say that one is an equal... or even more.」

853:t_76:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In fact, Mr. $$宗介$$, you've taken hit after hit from that one over several matchups.」

853:t_76:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「If you mean $$千鳥$$'s paper fan, I don't mind it. That's... our way of communicating.」

853:t_76:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do think about things with $$千鳥$$ in my own way.」

853:t_76:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Admirable. Allow me to honestly celebrate your growth as a person, Mr. $$宗介$$.」

853:t_77:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I don't need you to tell me that at this point. The title I want is something else.」

853:t_77:6.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I got that one ages ago. What I want is...」

853:t_77:8.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You get it! As expected of you, AG!」

853:t_77:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well... though I can already see it coming that if you keep saying things like that, the target who really matters will get fed up with you.」

853:t_77:10.en:
$$クルツ$$
「...You're right. With one huge battle after another...」

853:t_77:11.en:
$$クルツ$$
「I'm going to take a serious shot, too.」

853:t_77:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I wish you the best of luck, Mr. $$クルツ$$.」

853:t_78:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Skip the blessings and hurry up and hand over the bonus prize: a year's supply of beer.」

853:t_78:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-wait a moment! When and who set up such a bonus prize!?」

853:t_78:6.en:
$$マオ$$
「When? If you're asking when, now! Who? If you're asking who, me! Got a problem?」

853:t_78:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But if I'm paying out of my own pocket, then I'm taking my share of the drinks, too!」

853:t_78:9.en:
$$マオ$$
「Sure. Drinking with you ought to make for a cheerful party.」

853:t_78:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(An unexpected chance...! Mr. $$クルツ$$, please forgive me!)

853:t_78:11.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're on, AG! Come to my room in full protective gear!」

853:t_78:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Wh...! Is Miss $$マオ$$'s drinking party as dangerous as a battlefield!?」

853:t_78:13.en:
$$マオ$$
「One bullet for every sexual harassment word, one carton of magazines for every sexual harassment act... Come on over once you've got that resolve.」

853:t_79:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But please don't give up hope. Not everything is over yet.」

853:t_80:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$クルーゾー$$!」

853:t_80:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've got it all prepared. The disc of that anime, said to be the oldest masterpiece, that you requested, Mr. $$クルーゾー$$...」

853:t_80:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「However, since it's from quite a long time ago, it doesn't have a standard-language dub...」

853:t_80:7.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「No problem. I have completely mastered Old Japanese in order to appreciate works of that kind.」

853:t_80:8.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「By now I've gained the confidence to make it as a professional in that field.」

853:t_80:10.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Well, excuse me. For the next ten hours, I will be taking completely private time.」
